Value: Station point (one point per station; temporal dimension in attributes)
Derived from DB05 Climate Observations database

Derived from DB05 CLEAN. Two representations: (A) Station summary layer — one point per station with aggregated statistics (mean annual rainfall; mean temperature; record count; date range); (B) Annual/seasonal snapshot — one point per station per time period for mapping. G21 inherits G20 geometry. Step 1: DB05 must be CLEAN. Step 2: Aggregate DB05 by Station_ID and period. Step 3: Join to G20 geometry by Station_ID. Step 4: QC aggregated values. Step 5: Publish G21 CLEAN.
DB05 (must be CLEAN) | G20 (must be CLEAN — provides geometry)
GeoPackage preferred (summary layer); CSV for full time-series export

G21 is the spatial/aggregated representation of DB05. The full time-series remains in DB05. G21 provides station-level summaries for GIS mapping and is the direct input to G22 and G23 surface interpolation. When DB05 is updated G21 must be regenerated. The aggregation period (baseline years) must be documented — use longest available consistent record; minimum 10 years preferred for reliable means.
